summary: Management provides extensive medium-term and long-term targets across various segments. While near-term revenue figures show strong growth, several multi-year targets remain open and require future execution to judge reliably.
business: Dixon Technologies is an electronic manufacturing services (EMS) provider in India, operating segments including mobile phones, consumer electronics, home appliances, lighting, telecom, and IT hardware products.
bull: Consolidated annual revenue scaled significantly from INR 17,691 crores in FY24 to INR 48,873 crores in FY26.
Mobile and EMS revenue demonstrates robust sequential growth, reaching INR 20,093 crores in Q2 FY27.
Operating cash flows have improved steadily over the last three years from INR 584.0 to INR 1,782.0 crores.
bear: Borrowings have increased over the last three balance sheets from INR 671.0 crores to INR 1,236.0 crores.
EBITDA margins remain compressed, fluctuating around 2.7% to 3.9% across recent quarters.
Q2 FY27 PAT declined 44.9% YoY to INR 411 crores despite strong top-line growth.
